questions.question: What is the purpose of Benchmarks in ServiceNow ITSM?

options.text: To automatically prioritize incidents based on impact
To monitor KPIs over time and compare performance with other organizations
To set mandatory response times for all incidents
To generate automated email reports for management

explanation.correct: Benchmarks enable organizations to monitor key performance indicators over time and compare their performance with other organizations. Results can be filtered by location and viewed in percentile ranking. This helps organizations understand how they perform relative to industry peers and identify improvement opportunities.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Incident prioritization is based on impact and urgency matrix, not Benchmarks
Response times are defined in SLAs, not Benchmarks. Benchmarks are for performance comparison
Automated email reports are configured through Scheduled Reports, not Benchmarks

source.excerpt: Benchmarks enables companies to monitor key performance indicators over time and compare their performance to that of other organizations. Results can be filtered by location and viewed in percentile ranking.

questions.question: Which of the following are common ITSM KPIs that can be tracked through Benchmarks? (Select two)

options.text: Number of closed requests with breached SLAs
Total revenue generated by IT services

explanation.correct: Key ITSM metrics include incidents, problems, change, and service catalog metrics. Specific examples are the number of closed requests with breached SLAs, average fulfillment time, and requests per user. These metrics help organizations track service delivery performance and identify improvement areas.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Revenue tracking is a financial metric, not an ITSM KPI. ITSM focuses on service delivery metrics like resolution time and SLA compliance
Office furniture satisfaction is a Facilities metric, not an ITSM KPI. ITSM metrics focus on IT service delivery

source.excerpt: Regarding IT service management, important KPIs include incidents, problems, change, and service catalog metrics like the number of closed requests with breached SLAs, average fulfillment time, and requests per user.

questions.question: What is the purpose of configuring surveys for closed incidents?

options.text: To automatically reopen incidents based on negative feedback
To assess and monitor user perception of issue resolution
To calculate the SLA compliance percentage
To assign performance ratings to individual agents

explanation.correct: Surveys are configured to assess and monitor user perception of how well their issues were addressed. A Service Desk Satisfaction Survey can be triggered for closed incidents to gather customer feedback. Organizations typically limit survey frequency (e.g., one per 30 days per user) to avoid survey fatigue.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Surveys collect feedback but don't automatically reopen incidents. Reopening requires user action or specific conditions
SLA compliance is calculated from task records and SLA definitions, not from survey responses
While survey data can inform agent performance, the primary purpose is to assess user satisfaction with service delivery

source.excerpt: As an Incident Manager, I want to send a user satisfaction survey for every closed incident to assess and monitor the perception of the users on how well their issues were addressed.

questions.question: Which capability in ITSM Pro provides data visualizations to anticipate trends and drive IT alignment with business goals?

explanation.correct: Platform Analytics enables stakeholders, workers, owners, and executives to make smarter, real-time decisions. It uses data visualizations to anticipate trends, prioritize resources, and drive IT alignment with business goals. Platform Analytics is included in ITSM Pro.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Virtual Agent is an AI-powered chatbot for self-service, not for data visualization and trend analysis
Predictive Intelligence uses machine learning for ticket routing and recommendations, not for trend visualization
Continual Improvement Management is for managing improvement initiatives, not for data visualization

source.excerpt: Enable stakeholders, workers, owners and executives responsible for service delivery to make smarter, real time decisions with platform analytics. Use data visualizations to anticipate trends, prioritize resources, and drive IT alignment with business goals.

questions.question: Which workspace allows service owners to track and analyze how services are performing from a single integrated interface?

explanation.correct: Service Owner Workspace provides service owners with a single window to manage and monitor portfolios and services in one integrated and graphically intuitive user interface. It allows tracking and analysis of service performance and identification of services needing attention.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Service Operations Workspace is designed for agents handling IT service tasks, not for service owner portfolio management
Vendor Manager Workspace is for tracking and analyzing vendor performance, not service portfolio performance
Agent Workspace (now Service Operations Workspace) is for agents resolving tasks, not for service owners managing portfolios

source.excerpt: Service owner workspace provides service owners with a single window to manage and monitor portfolios and services in one integrated and graphically intuitive user interface. Track and analyze how your services are performing and which services need attention.

questions.question: An Incident Manager wants to send satisfaction surveys to users after incident closure, but not more than once per 30 days per user. Where is this limitation configured?

explanation.correct: Survey trigger conditions define when surveys are sent and include options to limit survey frequency per user. The trigger can be configured to prevent sending more than one survey to the same user within a specified period (e.g., 30 days), preventing survey fatigue while still collecting feedback.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Survey question properties define the question content, not the sending frequency
User profiles don't control survey frequency. This is managed in the survey trigger configuration
Email templates define the message format, not when or how often surveys are sent

source.excerpt: I do not want to send more than one survey in a 30 day period for the same user. Setup a new Survey Trigger conditions to send the 'Service Desk Satisfaction Survey' for every incident that moves to a Closed state.

questions.question: Which ITSM tier includes Continual Improvement Management and Predictive Intelligence?

explanation.correct: ITSM Professional builds on ITSM Standard with capabilities including Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence, Continual Improvement Management, Platform Analytics, Service Owner Workspace, Vendor Manager Workspace, and DevOps.

wrongAnswers.explanation: ITSM Standard includes the first eight core ITSM applications but not Pro-level features like Predictive Intelligence.
ITSM Enterprise builds on Standard and Pro with Process Optimization and Workforce Optimization, but Predictive Intelligence is part of Pro.
Now Platform provides the foundation, but Predictive Intelligence and CIM are specifically part of ITSM Professional.

source.excerpt: ITSM Professional consists of the following seven applications... Predictive Intelligence... Continual improvement management.

questions.question: Which two additional applications does ITSM Enterprise add on top of ITSM Standard and Professional?

explanation.correct: ITSM Enterprise builds off Standard and Professional with two additional applications: Process Optimization and Workforce Optimization. Virtual Agent and Predictive Intelligence are part of ITSM Professional.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Virtual Agent and Predictive Intelligence are part of ITSM Professional, not Enterprise additions.
Performance Analytics is part of ITSM Pro, and DevOps is also a Pro capability.
Service Mapping and Event Management are ITOM capabilities, not ITSM Enterprise additions.

source.excerpt: ITSM Enterprise builds off of Standard and Pro with two additional applications, Process Optimization and Workforce Optimization.

questions.question: Which three translation services are supported by default for Dynamic Translation in ServiceNow? (Choose three.)

explanation.correct: Dynamic Translation in ServiceNow uses IBM, Microsoft, and Google translation services by default. It can translate comments and work notes, enabling individuals to interact with the platform in their native language.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Amazon Translate is not listed as a default provider for Dynamic Translation in ServiceNow.
DeepL is not listed as a default provider for Dynamic Translation in ServiceNow.

source.excerpt: Translation services are provided by IBM, Microsoft, and Google by default.

questions.question: What is the Walk-up Experience application used for in ServiceNow ITSM?

options.text: Enabling users to check into a queue at a physical IT support location
Tracking employee badge access to server rooms

explanation.correct: Walk-up Experience enables users to check into a walk-up queue online, view the number of requesters in the queue, schedule appointments, and receive reminders. Large monitors at the physical location display walk-in requests and appointments.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Remote desktop support is not the purpose of Walk-up Experience. It's for physical, in-person IT support.
Badge access tracking is a physical security function, not part of Walk-up Experience.
Mobile device compliance is handled by MDM solutions, not Walk-up Experience.

source.excerpt: The Walkup Experience application enables users to check into a Walkup queue online, view the number of other requesters in the queue.

questions.question: Which feature on the Incident Overview page provides multiple dashboards of incident management metrics, including a count of unassigned incident records?
questions.explanation: The Incident Overview module (accessed via Incident > Overview) offers multiple dashboards of incident management metrics, including a clear count of unassigned incident records. Clicking on the count provides direct access to a list of those unassigned records.

wrongAnswers.Service Operations Workspace home: While SOW provides an overview of cases and assignments, the specific dashboards with unassigned incident counts are found in the Incident Overview module.
wrongAnswers.Performance Analytics Hub: Performance Analytics is a broader platform capability, not the specific module that provides the incident management metric dashboards described.
wrongAnswers.ITSM Dashboard: There is no specific module called 'ITSM Dashboard' that provides this functionality. The Incident Overview module is the correct location.

questions.question: Which TWO areas do surveys in ServiceNow ITSM focus on assessing? (Choose 2)
options: Effectiveness of resolution and support teams
Agent login frequency and session duration
correctAnswer: Effectiveness of resolution and support teams
questions.explanation: Surveys in ServiceNow ITSM focus on assessing the effectiveness of resolution and support teams, the speed of service restoration, and overall user contentment. This information helps organizations assess performance against SLAs and identify areas for improvement.

wrongAnswers.Technical accuracy of knowledge articles: Knowledge article accuracy is not a primary focus of ITSM surveys. Surveys focus on user experience, support effectiveness, and satisfaction.
wrongAnswers.Agent login frequency and session durati: Agent activity metrics are operational data, not assessed through user satisfaction surveys.

questions.question: Why is accurate data in the Service and Configuration Item fields critical for incident reporting?
options: These fields impact service level agreements, task assignment, and task priority calculations
These fields are required for incident creation and cannot be left blank
These fields determine which notification templates are used
These fields control which knowledge articles are displayed to agents
questions.correctAnswer: These fields impact service level agreements, task assignment, and task priority calculations
questions.explanation: The Service and Configuration Item fields automatically generate lists of affected CIs, impacted services, and configuration items. These fields impact service level agreements, task assignment, and task priority. They must be configured correctly so the system can assign SLAs, tasks, and priorities based on these items.

wrongAnswers.These fields are required for incident c: While important, these fields are not necessarily required (marked with a red asterisk) for incident creation.
wrongAnswers.These fields determine which notificatio: Notification templates are determined by incident state changes and other conditions, not primarily by the Service and CI fields.
wrongAnswers.These fields control which knowledge art: Knowledge article suggestions may consider service context, but the primary importance of these fields is their impact on SLAs, assignment, and priority.

questions.question: An ITSM process owner wants to compare their organization's incident resolution times against industry peers. Which ServiceNow capability should they use?
questions.explanation: Benchmarks enable companies to monitor KPIs over time and compare their performance to that of other organizations. Results can be filtered by location and viewed in percentile ranking. Important KPIs include incident, problem, change, and service catalog metrics.

wrongAnswers.Performance Analytics: Performance Analytics provides internal trend analysis and reporting but does not offer cross-organization comparison capabilities like Benchmarks.
wrongAnswers.Reporting dashboards: Reporting dashboards display internal metrics but do not provide industry peer comparison data.
wrongAnswers.Continual Improvement Management: CIM helps track and manage improvement initiatives but does not provide the cross-organization benchmarking comparison capability.

questions.question: Which THREE are limitations of the Benchmarks capability in ServiceNow? (Choose 3)
options: Specific plugins may require additional licensing
correctAnswer: Specific plugins may require additional licensing
questions.explanation: Benchmarks have specific limitations: they are not accessible to express, federal customers, or those with on-premise instances. Additionally, specific plugins may require additional licensing. Benchmarks cover multiple ITSM KPIs (incidents, problems, changes, service catalog) and do not require Enterprise licensing.

wrongAnswers.Limited to incident metrics only: Benchmarks cover multiple ITSM areas including incidents, problems, change, and service catalog metrics like breached SLAs, average fulfillment time, and requests per user.
wrongAnswers.Requires ITSM Enterprise license: Benchmarks are not limited to ITSM Enterprise. They require enablement on the instance but are available across ITSM tiers.

questions.question: A request manager notices that average fulfillment time has been increasing over the past quarter. They want to use ServiceNow's built-in capabilities to identify how their team compares to similar organizations. What should they review?
options: Benchmarks filtered by location with percentile ranking
SLA breach reports for the request process
questions.correctAnswer: Benchmarks filtered by location with percentile ranking
questions.explanation: Benchmarks enable companies to monitor KPIs like average fulfillment time over time and compare performance to other organizations. Results can be filtered by location and viewed in percentile ranking, allowing the request manager to see how their team's fulfillment time compares to industry peers.

wrongAnswers.The Service Catalog Overview dashboard: While this shows internal metrics, it does not provide comparison against other organizations' performance.
wrongAnswers.Individual agent performance reports: Agent-level reports show internal individual performance but don't provide external organizational comparisons.
wrongAnswers.SLA breach reports for the request proce: SLA breach reports track internal compliance but don't compare fulfillment times against peer organizations.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Schedule tab in Change Management from a reporting perspective?
options: It tracks planned versus actual start and end dates to identify disparities and improvement areas
It generates automated reports on change success rates
It calculates change risk scores based on scheduling conflicts
It provides a calendar view of all upcoming changes for the CAB
questions.correctAnswer: It tracks planned versus actual start and end dates to identify disparities and improvement areas
questions.explanation: The Schedule tab requires input of the estimated start and end date/time for implementation. Once the change is implemented, it automatically updates with actual dates. This is an excellent resource for reporting, enabling identification of disparities between planned and actual results to conclude areas requiring improvement in future implementations.

wrongAnswers.It generates automated reports on change: The Schedule tab tracks dates rather than generating automated success rate reports. Success rates come from closure information.
wrongAnswers.It calculates change risk scores based o: Risk calculation is performed separately via the Calculate Risk related link and risk assessment surveys, not the Schedule tab.
wrongAnswers.It provides a calendar view of all upcom: While the Schedule tab has date information, its reporting value is in comparing planned vs. actual dates, not providing a CAB calendar view.
